name: awardlanes
description: awardlanes is a read-only MCP connector for USDA food-purchase award lanes. Ask Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code or Cursor to search lanes in your up-to-three-state territory, open an award, summarize states, find a vendor's awards, or check your trial. Every result carries a USDA source link and a matching awardlanes view. During the trial or on a paid plan it uses the full territory; after an unpaid trial it returns the same 20-lane sample shown on the web. Equipment is inferred from the commodity name when USDA does not state it.

defaultPrompt: Find reefer award lanes from Texas that are open now.
Open USDA contract 12-3J14-26-C-2036 and show every destination and source.
Summarize my Texas and California territory: lanes, deliveries not started, f.o.b. share and top vendors.

positive.description: Search lanes by state, direction and equipment
positive.prompt: Find reefer award lanes from Texas that are open now.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to the requested number of lanes, each with its USDA source link and an awardlanes web link; says when equipment is inferred.

positive.prompt: Open USDA contract 12-3J14-26-C-2036 and show every destination and source.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that award's lanes, delivery dates, vendor and plant, USDA sources and the web view link.

positive.prompt: Summarize my Texas and California territory: lanes, deliveries not started, f.o.b. share and top vendors.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns counts and top vendors for the requested states (up to three).

positive.prompt: Show USDA awards for Victor Packing, with published contact details.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that vendor's awards and plant details, with a published business contact and its source when one exists.

positive.prompt: What is my awardlanes trial status and territory?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns plan or trial end date, territory states and the billing link.

negative.prompt: Delete the Texas lanes from my awardlanes account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the connector is read-only and calls no tool.

negative.prompt: Upgrade my awardlanes plan and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the connector takes no payments; at most points to the billing link from my_account.

negative.prompt: Find me a spot load on a load board for tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains awardlanes covers USDA award lanes only, not spot loads, and invents nothing.

review.commerce_description: This MCP connector provides data lookup and analysis only; it does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial remote Streamable HTTP MCP connector: OAuth 2.1 PKCE S256, dynamic client registration, consent signup, five read-only tools, shared web gating, hashed rotating tokens, revocation, tool-call analytics, and public docs/privacy copy. Equipment inference now prefers shelf-stable, canned and juice commodities before fruit; tool responses state when equipment is inferred, and MCP OAuth/proxy limits are bounded.
